findings.headline: Replace this deprecated Dynamic element with a dynamic() factory.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 keeps <Dynamic component={...}> working but deprecates it (no runtime warning): the tag travels in the props bag, so every instance pays a merge at the call site, an omit inside, and a fresh factory memo that a JSX wrapper cannot hoist.
findings.guidance: Hoist const Tag = dynamic(() => <the component expression>) to the component body, or to the module for a constant tag, and render <Tag {...the remaining props} />; inside a For callback the callback body is the place to hoist. Keep Dynamic as is when the migration is staged and the deprecation is acceptable for now.
